summary: The prior-round findings remain addressed in the revised text. One new integrity gap still prevents approval: the verified source is not cryptographically or transactionally bound to the host-side code ultimately installed and executed.

recommendations.location: Premises / live-evidence manifest; Installer & skill dispatch, steps 3–5
recommendations.issue: [P1] Live evidence is keyed to the image, runtime profile, schema, and AGENTS.md, but not to the host-side enforcement implementation. Changes to sandbox.py, broker.py, premises.py, stream/secret handling, or the battery can therefore retain apparently current evidence when their semantic profile values are unchanged. Moreover, the installer verifies the source tree and then performs an unspecified copy into an existing skill directory; interruption or concurrent modification can leave a mixed,未
recommendations.suggestion: Create an immutable staged installation artifact and include its canonical tree/package digest—covering all host-side enforcement, battery, publication, and skill-dispatch files—in the premise and live-evidence fingerprints. Run tests and live gates against that exact staged artifact, install it via an atomic directory replacement, then hash and revalidate the installed bytes before activation.
